scope: Skip hidden glass rendering behind fully opaque fullscreen clients.

checks.command: KWin 6.7.4 hardware frame log on a 1920x1080 virtual Wayland output, AMD Radeon integrated GPU, Golden Gate material, fullscreen Qt Quick animation. Previous effect-on median render time 4.83 ms versus 2.02 ms off. Candidate effect-on medians 2.030 and 2.032 ms versus 2.036 and 2.079 ms off. All four candidate windows sustained 60 FPS.

On native isolated KWin X11 and Wayland, all 614400 opaque fullscreen pixels matched effect-off; the transparent fullscreen control retained glass on 546240 pixels. Partial damage and full repaint matched on both backends.
Compile the effect for the 6.6.4, 6.7.4 and 6.8.2 Wayland SDKs and native 6.7.4 X11.

coverage_limits: The frame log measures an opaque fullscreen animation on a virtual output. It does not establish the cost of every installed desktop component, game, driver or refresh rate.
